tutorial.text: Walk to the pier end — cast where the water meets the boards
Catch 3 fish (hold to cast, tap Reel in the green window)
Carry fish to the teal pad left of the cutter
Pick up portions from the pad on the cutter's right
Stock the counter so customers can buy
Stand at the counter until a sale rings up
Open Upgrades and buy a bigger bag
Open Jobs, accept a harbor contract, and deliver it
Open Staff and hire your first hand once Make 10 sales unlocks hiring
After Fill the hold unlocks the grill, deliver fish to the charcoal grill pad
